name: Linoleum
desc: An institutional corridor floor running out to a hazed horizon — jaspe lino marbled by dragging two colours of mix together, welded seams crossing the sheets, black heel marks scuffed into the wax, the polish walked off down the middle where the jute backing is starting to come through, and the ceiling tubes smeared into long columns on what wax is left.

wear.doc: 0 = newly laid and waxed · 1.4 = decades of footfall, pattern faded, backing through in the lane

scale.doc: how wide the corridor reads — sheet width, marbling and tile size together

energy.doc: how hard the ceiling tubes burn on the wax

density.doc: how busy the marbling is, and how wide the seams sit

hue.doc: re-tints the lino (96 = true institutional green; ~30 reads the old brown)

speed.doc: rate of the camera dolly and the light walking the wax

x.doc: vanishing point across the frame — swings the corridor left or right

y.doc: horizon height — how much of the frame the floor takes

style.doc: jaspe: classic marbled sheet lino, institutional green-grey streaked through · vct: vinyl composition tile — filler chips pressed into a hard 12-inch grid, waxed hard · worn: decades of footfall, the pattern faded and the backing coming through · oxblood: a dark period lino, near-monochrome and sombre · wearmap: non-representational — footfall as false-colour contour bands, no floor, no corridor, no light, just where people walked

act.doc: dolly: the camera drifts steadily down the corridor · buff: the camera nearly stops and the machine works the wax up · scuff: the heel marks and traffic build and get cleaned back across sections

seed.doc: a different building — new marbling, seam runs, scuffs and wear pattern
